description: This file defines the LinkDialog class for managing link insertion/editing in the Summernote WYSIWYG editor, including UI setup, event handling, and dialog interactions.

classes.name: LinkDialog
classes.description: Class for handling the link insertion/edit dialog in Summernote editor.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the LinkDialog with the given editor context.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Sets up the dialog UI elements and appends it to the DOM.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Removes the dialog from the DOM and hides it.

methods.name: bindEnterKey
methods.description: Binds Enter key press to trigger the link button.

methods.name: toggleLinkBtn
methods.description: Enables or disables the insert link button based on input values.

methods.name: showLinkDialog
methods.description: Displays the link dialog and handles user input, returning a promise.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Triggers the process to show the link dialog with current link info.
